verdict.rationale: The evidence shows some event-driven automation. Agentic workflows auto-remediate level 1 alerts and auto-escalate high-risk cases, and agent configurations are implied to be customizable outside the Starter Plan. Users can also configure the risk-score equation and screening configurations. However, nothing documents a user-authored rule engine of the form 'when event X, do action Y'. Webhooks are outbound notifications, not rules, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented user-defined trigger/condition/action rule builder, a list of supported events and actions, details of how agent behavior is customized, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
